Cobra causes 30-minute traffic halt in Bengaluru

A cobra was spotted on Palace Road in Bengaluru, causing rush-hour traffic to come to a standstill for approximately 30 minutes. Commuters reportedly froze as the snake disrupted the flow of vehicles. The incident highlights unusual occurrences that can impact daily life in the city.
